question: Select the personality who received the Sangeet Natak Akademi 2021 award for his/her contribution in Mohiniyattam.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Neena Prasad**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** personality who received the Sangeet Natak Akademi Award 2021 **for her contribution to **Mohiniyattam is Neena Prasad.**
 
• She trained under prominent gurus,** including Kalamandalam Sugandhi and Kalamandalam Kshemavathi.**
 
• She has founded **Bharata Ilango Foundation for Asian Culture (BIFAC)** in Thiruvananthapuram
 
• It is a **centre dedicated to **the promotion of classical dance and research.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mohiniyattam**:

 
 
• It is a **classical dance form of Kerala**, characterized by its graceful, swaying movements, feminine charm, and storytelling through expressions (abhinaya).
 
• It is **known as the "dance of the enchantress", it embodies beauty and devotion**
 
• Dr. Sunanda Nair became the first in India to acquire a Master’s degree in Mohiniyattam.
 
• She completed her Ph.D. thesis in Intrinsic Lyrical Feminism in Mohiniyattam from Mumbai University.
 
• Mohiniyattam is based on Natya Shastra’s lasya style. 
 
• It has delicate movements and more feminine facial expressions.
 
• The movements are gentle and glide-like. They do not have terse rhythmic steps. 
 
• More emphasis is on the facial expressions and hand gestures.
